description: Phase 3D validation plan for the nine final L01-L56 DLM outputs, separate from the core and Batch A/B/C plans. All three references are the AUDITED_L56_RECONSTRUCTION (Phase 1 audit: legacy siecc_fit_dlm at max_lag 56 on the audited data, 10,000 MVN draws, cross-checked by an independent re-derivation); no original deposited L56 output exists. Every reference marked required is required: an absent, undeclared or incomplete reference FAILS; unmatched, duplicated or blank keys, missing required columns, record-count mismatches and non-finite disagreements FAIL. Tolerance classes: 'dlm' (existing named set), 'exact' (existing), 'seeded' (declared in config/dlm_validation_protocol.json: 1e-9 abs + 1e-9 rel; exact seeded reproduction). No existing tolerance is changed.

references.name: dlmL56_audited_estimates
references.scope: nine final M2-L DLMs: n, global statistic and p, q9, cumulative effect/SE/CI at L56, peak effect

references.name: dlmL56_audited_discrete
references.scope: peak lag and the numbers of lags whose pointwise and simultaneous bands exclude zero (10,000-draw recomputation)

references.name: dlmL56_audited_critical_10000
references.scope: exact seeded reproduction of the simultaneous critical value at the audited draw count (10,000 draws, seed 20260729 + 100 * metric_index + outcome_index)
